description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over training steps for six different model architectures—ChemBART Small 20M (red), ChemBART Medium 20M (blue), ChemBERTa Small 20M (green), ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange), ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple), and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown)—all trained on a dataset of 20 million data points. The x-axis, labeled "Step," is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0K to 440K, with major tick marks at intervals of 20K. The y-axis, labeled "Train Loss," is also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.85. All six lines begin at a high training loss near 0.75 at step 0K and exhibit a rapid initial decline, stabilizing at a low loss value around 0.05 to 0.10 after approximately 40K steps. The green line (ChemBERTa Small 20M) and the brown line (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) appear to reach the lowest final loss values, while the red line (ChemBART Small 20M) starts with the highest loss and remains relatively high until around 40K steps before converging. All lines show some fluctuation around their final loss values, particularly after 40K steps, with the green line showing the most pronounced oscillations.
